description: Any Home Assistant sensor as big type over its own rolling history line — temperature, power, CO₂. Several entities rotate like a board; thresholds pin the scale and color the value with a polarity (band, lower-is-better, higher-is-better).

settings.label: Entities
settings.note: Search to add entities (numeric sensors graph; others show as text until numbers arrive). Thresholds pin the graph's scale and color the value, and the ◦/</> button picks the polarity: Band (green inside Low…High), Lower-is-better (green below Low, amber to High, red above — CO₂) or Higher-is-better (battery). In the add-on this works automatically; standalone Docker needs COMPANION_HA_URL + COMPANION_HA_TOKEN set.
